description: Relevance judgements for the scale benchmark. retrieval_cases.json only labels the 17 demo records, but the scale collections hold tens of thousands of real FDA reports, and some describe the same problem as a test report. Every non-demo record that `run` or `decide` showed for a test report (top 5 by score, candidates above the threshold, and what survived Gemini's check, at every size) was read and judged by hand, by the rule the eval uses: the same symptom on the same kind of part, with any failed sterility test (Bowie-Dick, biological or chemical indicator) counting as one problem. Q8 and Q9 name a steam autoclave, so failed tests on other kinds of sterilizer do not count for them; Q10 says only 'sterilizer'. Close calls were judged not the same, and 'why_not' says why. 'same' records count as right answers alongside the eval's 'expected'; for a negative, showing a 'same' record first is not a false alarm. A record shown that is in neither list is unjudged and counted wrong; the benchmark prints any it finds so they can be judged here.
